articles.title: Seoul Circuit
articles.summary: Black base with glowing mint-teal rounded panel cascades and lilac seams, like a circuit board city at night. Reads as a black car with large glowing teal-mint panel shapes and a few purple accents, like a futuristic city skyline or HUD screens.
articles.what: Rounded luminous panel cascades and mint-lilac city-current seams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish. Up close: Black field with big glowing rounded-rectangle panels (150-300 px) in mint green, overlapping like stacked screens, each outlined by a bright neon rim and filled with fine slanted hairlines. Triangles of magenta and lilac sit inside some panels, and faint thin lines with ring nodes run behind them. From a distance: Reads as a black car with large glowing teal-mint panel shapes and a few purple accents, like a futuristic city skyline or HUD screens. Avoid small trim: shapes need room

Thin neon pinstripes: echo the panel edges

Patterns to avoid: other neon, stripe or streak patterns: colours muddy; fine grain: lost under the blur
Spec overlays that work: gloss clear bands: contrast against the satin; avoid sparkle spec
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

articles.title: Signglass Shatter
articles.summary: Shattered stained-glass shards in purple, magenta and blue with white-hot glowing rims. Reads as a dark purple-magenta mosaic with bright white-pink crack lines; the rims survive as a web of glowing lines, the cell colours blend to deep plum.
articles.what: Broken sign-glass territories with white-hot rims and dying phosphor interiors. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish. Up close: Stained-glass cells of crimson, magenta, violet, blue and near-black, each with a soft dark inner glow and a thin white-hot rim edged cyan or pink. A few cells are inky black, one is green; faint fine grain inside the panes. From a distance: Reads as a dark purple-magenta mosaic with bright white-pink crack lines; the rims survive as a web of glowing lines, the cell colours blend to deep plum. Measured spec (average): metal 23, roughness 62, coat 123. Shine: satin. Metal: none. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, roof.
Fits: show car, gt / sports car, open wheel.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Signglass Shatter" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood, roof and doors: big flat panels show whole cells and rims
Skip small trim, shards turn to noise
Numbers need a plate or heavy white/black outline; the rims and dark-vs-bright cells swallow plain numbers.
Almost nothing: it is already a loud full-colour mosaic, a second pattern fights the rims
Pairs well with: black, white, chrome, gold.
pitfalls: Not real stained glass: no lead lines, the rims are glowing white
Not a hologram: colours do not shift with angle
Avoid: numbers get lost in the shards, next to other loud patterns.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 23 (low metal, like carbon or subtle flake), roughness 62 (satin gloss), clearcoat 123 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: numbers get lost in the shards, next to other loud patterns.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: it is already a loud full-colour mosaic, a second pattern fights the rims; solid-colour number plates or a plain panel kept clean for numbers
Patterns to avoid: camo, carbon, stripes: compete with the shard web
Spec overlays that work: none needed; a faint fine grain spec at most, so the satin sheen stays calm
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

articles.title: Midnight Drift
articles.summary: Black ground with curved rainbow skid-light and ember heat, glossy and fluid. Reads as a dark car with a few big glowing neon swooshes in cyan and hot pink; the haze zones look like dim brown-red smoke.
articles.what: Backlit drift haze, curved skid-light and ember heat moving laterally through black. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish. Up close: Large looping ribbons of light on near-black: each ribbon is a cyan core edged in magenta, pink and orange like a long-exposure skid trail. Between loops are dull maroon and teal haze zones, one with a pinwheel centre. A fine screen-like diagonal moire grain covers everything. From a distance: Reads as a dark car with a few big glowing neon swooshes in cyan and hot pink; the haze zones look like dim brown-red smoke. Measured spec (average): metal 31, roughness 34, coat 81. Shine: gloss. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, hood.
Fits: show car, gt / sports car, stock car.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Midnight Drift" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Doors and quarters: a ribbon sweeps across the side
Hood: loops read as a single glow trail; avoid tiny trim
Numbers over the bright ribbons get lost; place white numbers on the dark haze zones or use a plate.
Almost nothing: the ribbons are the design
Pairs well with: black, chrome, orange, teal.
pitfalls: Not a rainbow hologram: hue stays at the ribbon edges, centres are cyan
Not flames: the old tags say flames, but the shapes are smooth light trails
Avoid: numbers over the swirls, next to other rainbow finishes.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 31 (low metal, like carbon or subtle flake), roughness 34 (high gloss), clearcoat 81 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: the ribbons are the design; a very faint fine grain: only if the black areas feel too flat
